gr.title: «Αποθηκεύστε νερό και τρόφιμα για 3 μέρες, να έχετε μετρητά» -Η Βρετανία ζητά από τους πολίτες να είναι έτοιμοι για πόλεμο ή ολικό μπλακάουτ
gr.description: Σε κατάσταση αυξημένης ετοιμότητας καλούνται να βρίσκονται τα νοικοκυριά στη Βρετανία καθώς η κυβέρνηση εγκαινιάζει εκστρατεία ενημέρωσης των πολιτών για την αντιμετώπιση έκτακτων καταστάσεων. Από ακραία καιρικά φαινόμενα και κυβερνοεπιθέσεις έως πιθανές διαταραχές στις βασικές υπηρεσίες και τις αλυσίδες εφοδιασμού, οι οδηγίες προς τους πολίτες προβλέπουν τη συγκέντρωση αποθεμάτων τροφίμων και νερού για τουλάχιστον τρεις ημέρες, τη διατήρηση μετρητών για την περίπτωση κατάρρευσης των ηλεκτρονικών πληρωμών, καθώς και την προμήθεια βασικού εξοπλισμού για την αντιμετώπιση παρατεταμένων διακοπών ρεύματος. Αν και η εκστρατεία εστιάζει στην καθημερινή πολιτική προστασία, οι προειδοποιήσεις ανώτερων στρατιωτικών αξιωματούχων για την ανάγκη προετοιμασίας απέναντι σε ενδεχόμενες απειλές και πολεμικά σενάρια προσδίδουν στην πρωτοβουλία ευρύτερη διάσταση. Η λίστα ελέγχου των απαραίτητων μέτρων, την οποία οι πολίτες ενθαρρύνονται να εκτυπώσουν και να έχουν σε εύκολα προσβάσιμο σημείο, περιλαμβάνει επίσης ένα ραδιόφωνο με χειροκίνητη μανιβέλα ή μπαταρίες, καθώς και ένα φορητό σύστημα τροφοδοσίας για τη φόρτιση ηλεκτρονικών συσκευών σε περίπτωση διακοπής ρεύματος. Κυβερνοεπιθέσεις και φόβοι για σαμποτάζ θέτουν σε συναγερμό τις αρχές Η σύσταση για ενίσχυση της ετοιμότητας των νοικοκυριών διατυπώθηκε την ώρα που οργανισμοί σε όλο τον κόσμο προσπαθούν να αντιμετωπίσουν ένα κρίσιμο κενό ασφαλείας στη γλώσσα προγραμματισμού PHP, η οποία χρησιμοποιείται στη μεγάλη πλειονότητα των ιστοτόπων. Η Ντάουνινγκ Στριτ δήλωσε ότι δεν έχουν επηρεαστεί κρίσιμες υπηρεσίες του Ηνωμένου Βασιλείου που απευθύνονται στο κοινό. Ωστόσο, 32 κυβερνητικοί ιστότοποι έχουν τεθεί προσωρινά εκτός λειτουργίας, προκειμένου να αντιμετωπιστούν τα προβλήματα. Εκπρόσωπος της Ντάουνινγκ Στριτ ανέφερε ότι ειδικοί του Εθνικού Κέντρου Κυβερνοασφάλειας συνεργάζονται με την OpenAI, η τεχνολογία της οποίας χρησιμοποιήθηκε για τον εντοπισμό των ευπαθειών, καθώς και με συνεργάτες σε όλο τον κόσμο, για την αντιμετώπιση πιθανών κινδύνων. Τρεις ημέρες αυτάρκειας: Τι πρέπει να περιλαμβάνει το απόθεμα έκτακτης ανάγκης Μιλώντας κατά την έναρξη λειτουργίας του εργοστασίου UK Gun Hall, στο Τέλφορντ, ο Βρετανός υπουργός Άμυνας, Γουές Στρίτινγκ, αναφέρθηκε στο μήνυμα που επιχειρεί να μεταφέρει η κυβέρνηση στους πολίτες, θέτοντας το ερώτημα κατά πόσο είναι προετοιμασμένοι για το ενδεχόμενο διαταραχών στις βασικές αλυσίδες εφοδιασμού, εξαιτίας ενεργειών εχθρικών κρατικών παραγόντων ή τρομοκρατών. «Πώς θα αντεπεξέλθουμε αν καταρρεύσουν τα συστήματα πληρωμών στο τοπικό μας σούπερ μάρκετ;» διερωτήθηκε. «Αυτές είναι καθημερινές προκλήσεις και απειλές που θα μπορούσαμε κάλλιστα να αντιμετωπίσουμε. Είναι, επομένως, σωστό να ζητήσουμε από τη χώρα να προετοιμαστεί για τέτοια ενδεχόμενα και από όλους να κάνουν το καθήκον τους», πρόσθεσε. Σύμφωνα με τον ιστότοπο Be Ready, το πρώτο βήμα είναι η συγκέντρωση επαρκών προμηθειών για τρεις ημέρες, ώστε τα νοικοκυριά να μπορούν να καλύψουν τις βασικές ανάγκες τους, «μέχρι να φτάσει βοήθεια σε όσους τη χρειάζονται περισσότερο». Οι συστάσεις περιλαμβάνουν την αποθήκευση τριών λίτρων πόσιμου νερού ανά άτομο ημερησίως, καθώς και επιπλέον ποσότητας για άλλες χρήσεις, όπως το μαγείρεμα και το πλύσιμο. Τα αποθέματα τροφίμων θα πρέπει να περιλαμβάνουν προϊόντα μακράς διάρκειας, τα οποία δεν χρειάζονται ψύξη ή μαγείρεμα. Ενδεικτικά αναφέρονται κονσερβοποιημένα τρόφιμα, όπως κρέας, ψάρι και λαχανικά, καθώς και αποξηραμένα φρούτα και ξηροί καρποί. «Είναι προτιμότερο να αγοράζετε τρόφιμα που καταναλώνετε συνήθως», αναφέρει ο ιστότοπος. Στις συστάσεις περιλαμβάνονται επίσης κουβέρτες, υπνόσακοι και ζεστά ρούχα, καθώς «τα σπίτια μπορεί να κρυώσουν πολύ γρήγορα όταν διακοπεί η θέρμανση». Για τον φωτισμό προτείνονται φακοί αντί για κεριά, λόγω του κινδύνου πρόκλησης πυρκαγιάς. Όσον αφορά τα μετρητά, οι οδηγίες συνιστούν τη διατήρηση ενός συνδυασμού κερμάτων και χαρτονομισμάτων, σε περίπτωση που διακοπεί η λειτουργία των ηλεκτρονικών πληρωμών ή των ΑΤΜ. «Το ποσό των μετρητών που πρέπει να διατηρείτε εξαρτάται από τις συγκεκριμένες ανάγκες της οικογένειάς σας για την κάλυψη βασικών αναγκών», αναφέρει ο ιστότοπος. Παράλληλα, οι πολίτες καλούνται να διατηρούν εκτυπωμένα αντίγραφα σημαντικών εγγράφων, όπως διαβατήρια, πιστοποιητικά γέννησης, ασφαλιστήρια συμβόλαια, καθώς και οδηγίες χρήσης για τον ιατρικό εξοπλισμό από τον οποίο εξαρτώνται. Εκτός από την προμήθεια ραδιοφώνου με χειροκίνητη μανιβέλα ή μπαταρίες, συνιστάται στα νοικοκυριά να καταγράψουν τις συχνότητες των εθνικών ή τοπικών ραδιοφωνικών σταθμών από τους οποίους ενημερώνονται, ώστε να μπορούν να παρακολουθούν τις εξελίξεις κατά τη διάρκεια μιας διακοπής ρεύματος. Οι οικογένειες με βρέφη καλούνται να διαθέτουν έτοιμο βρεφικό γάλα ή γάλα έτοιμο προς κατανάλωση, καθώς ενδέχεται να μην είναι δυνατός ο βρασμός νερού για την ασφαλή παρασκευή γάλακτος σε σκόνη. «Προμηθευτείτε όσα σας λείπουν σταδιακά, κατά τη διάρκεια των τακτικών αγορών σας, ώστε να κατανείμετε το κόστος», αναφέρει ο ιστότοπος. Ο ιστότοπος προτρέπει, επίσης, τους πολίτες να συζητούν με τους γείτονές τους για την πρόσθετη βοήθεια που θα μπορούσαν να προσφέρουν ο ένας στον άλλον σε περίπτωση διακοπής ρεύματος, καθώς και να ανταλλάσσουν στοιχεία επικοινωνίας. Ο ιστότοπος προτρέπει, επίσης, τους πολίτες να συζητούν με τους γείτονές τους για την πρόσθετη βοήθεια που θα μπορούσαν να προσφέρουν ο ένας στον άλλον σε περίπτωση διακοπής ρεύματος, καθώς και να ανταλλάσσουν στοιχεία επικοινωνίας.

ph.title: PEZA tops P300B investment target
ph.description: THE Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) on Thursday said it had exceeded its P300-billion investment target this year and was on track to surpass the record P311.9 billion set in 2012. Investment approvals reached P309.63 billion as of its latest board meeting in October, up 76.56 percent from P175.37 billion in the same period last year. The approvals cover 240 new and expansion projects expected to generate $9.12 billion in exports and 38,815 direct jobs. “Surpassing our P300-billion investment target ahead of year-end reflects the confidence investors continue to place in the Philippines,” PEZA Director General Tereso Panga said. PEZA said sustained investor interest would help it beat the record set during the administration of then-president Benigno Aquino III. The approved projects span manufacturing, information technology and business process management, facilities, ecozone development, logistics, domestic market enterprises, utilities and tourism. Taiwan, the Netherlands, South Korea, Singapore and Indonesia were the leading sources of foreign direct investments in Philippine economic zones. “These results show that the Philippines can capture a larger share of global investment as companies look for competitive production and export locations,” Panga said. He added that international partnerships and improvements in the ease of doing business could strengthen local supply chains, support technology transfer and create more opportunities for local businesses. In October alone, the PEZA board approved 18 new and expansion projects worth P12.49 billion, expected to generate $178.2 million in exports and 5,484 direct jobs. Eight projects will be located in Calabarzon, six in the National Capital Region, two in Cebu, and one each in Central Luzon and Iloilo. PEZA said it would continue working with existing locators and potential investors to address operational and regulatory bottlenecks, and help businesses maintain and expand their Philippine operations. The priority is to sustain the momentum and turn investment commitments into operating projects that would boost exports and create jobs, Panga added.

ph.title: The silver lining behind the dark clouds
ph.description: THE dark clouds over our economy have been gathering throughout the year and strong winds have been blowing hard on our stock market, our currency and even our food supply. As a perennial optimist, I always like to consider the opportunities and the silver lining that could get us through this storm. We are in this challenging situation right now for two major reasons. First is the US-Iran war that we have no control over, and our governance breakdown, which has eroded confidence among both investors and even the implementing government agencies that are now reluctant to approve new projects. We have control over the second and should resolve this issue soon. The latest IMF World Economic Outlook for Philippine GDP growth has been lowered to 3.4 percent for 2026. The outlook specifically mentioned delays in public infrastructure spending and geopolitical headwinds. It also mentioned sluggish investments. According to the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), foreign direct investments (FDI) only reached $4.07 billion as of July, which is a decline of 23.9 percent compared to the same period last year. The decline was driven by lower capital investments as well as a drop in debt instruments. The BSP projects full-year FDI inflows to reach only $7.0 billion, which is lower than last year. This loss of investor confidence can be traced to our internal unresolved governance and political issues because FDI continues to flow into other countries unaffected by the external problems. In Vietnam, for instance, FDI disbursed surged by 12.1 percent and reached $21.07 billion by September, which is the highest level in the past five years. The Philippine inflation rate stands at 5.4 percent from January to September. It accelerated again last month to 7.2 percent, matching April’s three-year high. The peso has also fallen to a record low of P63.09 per US dollar as of Oct. 19, depreciating by roughly 6.82 percent since the start of the year. Putting pressure on the peso is the wider trade and balance of payments deficit, which reached a record high of $9.1 billion as of September. A big part of this deficit is our fuel importation. So where is the silver lining? Surging demand for artificial intelligence is expected to boost our biggest export industry — electronic manufacturing to a record year. According to the Semiconductor and Electronics Industries in the Philippines Foundation Inc., the industry expects our electronic exports to reach $54 billion, a 10 percent increase from last year. This will be the first time that this sector will breach the $50 billion threshold. While we are not producing specialized AI chips, we are providing supporting semiconductors that power data centers and critical digital infrastructure. In other words, we are well positioned to catch this wave of AI build-up with the capabilities that we already built in the past years. In addition to the AI requirements, we are seeing a growth in traditional sectors that are already in place in the country, such as automotive electronics, telecommunications and tracking devices. Automotive electronic sensor devices are even becoming mandatory for some countries, so this will continue driving demand and is expected to grow much further. In addition to our electronic exports, our BPO and IT-BPM industry continues to grow and is projected to to hit $42 billion in revenues and employ over 1.97 million full-time workers this year. This is expected to grow to 2.5 million jobs by 2028. Our fear that AI will eliminate jobs did not happen because over half of the local BPO firms are actively scaling AI integration to handle routine tasks, shifting humans toward higher-value judgment and data-driven roles. This market is pivoting from voice support to specialized services and global capacity centers. This industry has a bright future despite the naysayers and will continue to remain a silver lining. Despite the war in the Middle East and the US immigration crackdown, overseas Filipino worker remittances are projected to grow and will not decrease as initially feared, albeit at a modest scale of 2.7 percent to around $36.4 billion. Our foreign workers remain resilient and continue to provide the economic cushion to our society that needs their support. Industry intelligence projects the broader remittance market to expand at compound annual rate growth rate of 5.97 through 2031. This source of income is consistently strong and is expected to remain a lifeline for countless families. It’s not all that bad. We still have industry sectors that are outperforming previous records. We all know that we could achieve more. We just hope that the dark clouds will dissipate and the light will shine again. Ronald Goseco is an independent director of IMI, a global electronics manufacturing solutions company.

pg.title: PNG Mobile Network Sharing Could Cut Costs and Expand Rural Coverage
pg.description: Reducing the cost of expanding mobile coverage in Papua New Guinea is among the expected benefits of a voluntary infrastructure-sharing initiative welcomed by the National Information and Communications Technology Authority (NICTA). The authority believes closer cooperation between telecommunications operators could make better use of existing towers and related facilities, helping companies invest more efficiently while improving connectivity for people in underserved parts of PNG. Extending telecommunications services throughout the country requires substantial financial resources. PNG's challenging landscape, remote settlements and dispersed population make the construction and maintenance of network facilities particularly costly. NICTA said infrastructure sharing offered a practical way for operators to limit unnecessary duplication and make existing investments work harder. Resources that would otherwise be spent on building additional facilities could instead be directed towards improving coverage, service quality and network technology. The initiative is also being viewed as an indication that telecommunications operators are increasingly prepared to cooperate on common industry concerns and pursue solutions that benefit both businesses and consumers. NICTA said the benefits of sharing infrastructure could extend beyond individual companies, potentially supporting stronger connectivity and more affordable services over time. “Infrastructure sharing is a practical demonstration that telecommunications operators can work together in the broader interests of the industry and the people of Papua New Guinea. When operators share infrastructure and reduce avoidable costs, the benefits can extend beyond individual businesses to improved connectivity, wider coverage and, over time, more affordable services for consumers.” The authority has called on participating companies to build on the initiative by identifying further opportunities to share telecommunications towers, sites, shelters, power systems and other facilities where appropriate. NICTA said any agreements must be developed openly, with fair commercial conditions and safeguards to ensure that competition between service providers remains intact. It also reminded operators that voluntary arrangements do not remove their obligations under PNG's telecommunications legislation, licences and regulatory framework. The authority will continue to monitor the industry and use its statutory powers when required to protect consumer interests, maintain competition and promote responsible investment. NICTA said the initiative was consistent with its broader goal of supporting a competitive, innovative and sustainable ICT sector that contributes to the country's digital development agenda. By encouraging cooperation and more efficient use of infrastructure, the authority hopes operators will be better positioned to extend services into rural and remote locations where network deployment remains a major obstacle. NICTA acknowledged the companies taking part and encouraged continued collaboration, expressing hope that the initiative would help establish a stronger culture of infrastructure sharing and investment efficiency across PNG's telecommunications industry.

This direction also reflects the UAE’s confidence in the Hellenic Republic’s economic and investment strengths, its strategic location and its role in connecting European markets with regional and international markets, alongside the promising opportunities it offers to develop major projects and long-term partnerships. The expansion of the joint investment initiative will help strengthen cooperation between investment institutions and companies in both countries, drawing on their complementary expertise and capabilities to develop strategic projects, support innovation and the exchange of knowledge and expertise, and open new avenues for investment in sectors that contribute to sustainable economic development. ae.title: IMF forecasts UAE economic growth of 7.7% in 2027
ae.description: Dubai: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has projected that the UAE economy will grow by 7.7% in 2027, an increase of 2.4 percentage points compared to its forecasts issued last April, highlighting the country’s substantial financial buffers, advanced infrastructure, and economic and technological capabilities that strengthen its readiness to seize future growth opportunities and address regional and global challenges. The announcement came during a press conference organised by the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), in cooperation with the IMF, under the theme "Resilience in the Face of Challenges: Diverging Economic Outlooks in the Middle East and North Africa.” During the conference, Dr. Jihad Azour, Director of the IMF’s Middle East and Central Asia Department, presented the key findings of the October 2026 Regional Economic Outlook for the Middle East and Central Asia. The press conference was followed by a panel discussion featuring policymakers, economists, and private-sector leaders. The report highlighted the UAE’s substantial financial buffers, which provide flexibility to use fiscal policies to support economic activity when needed, within a credible medium-term framework that preserves fiscal sustainability. It also emphasised the importance of investment in infrastructure development, strengthening supply-chain efficiency, and supporting business continuity. Dr. Azour said that the region’s economies have demonstrated resilience in dealing with economic crises, benefiting from the experience and policies developed over recent years, including measures implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic, which helped maintain economic activity, support affected sectors, and accelerate recovery. He explained that the UAE is among the countries best positioned to benefit from rapid developments in artificial intelligence, thanks to its previous investments, advanced infrastructure, and technological capabilities. He noted that continued investment in AI could add approximately 0.5 percentage points to the UAE’s annual economic growth. The report also indicated that AI adoption could increase annual economic growth across the Middle East and Central Asia by between 0.1 and 0.6 percentage points over the medium term, with gains varying according to countries’ readiness and their ability to deploy advanced technologies. It emphasised the importance of continued investment in digital infrastructure, human capital development, skills training, and innovation ecosystems, alongside the development of exportable AI-based services for global markets, helping improve productivity and diversify sources of growth. Regarding inflation, the report projected that average inflation across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries would decline to 2.4% in 2027 and reach approximately 2% from 2028 onwards, supported by falling commodity prices and continued fiscal discipline. The report further stressed that export and market diversification, the development of alternative trade corridors, and stronger economic integration are key factors in enhancing the region’s resilience to external shocks. It highlighted the importance of developing transport and logistics infrastructure and strengthening trade connectivity among countries. The IMF also emphasised that investment in education, skills development, and labour market flexibility can boost productivity and support economic diversification, alongside continued structural reforms, improvements to the investment environment, and a stronger role for the private sector. The report noted that the IMF has approved approximately US$48 billion in financing for countries in the Middle East and Central Asia since 2020 and implemented 437 technical assistance and capacity development projects across 31 countries during fiscal year 2026, as part of its efforts to support economic stability and sustainable development. It concluded that leveraging global technological transformations, strengthening trade integration, and diversifying economic activities would create new opportunities for countries across the region to increase productivity, expand investment, and establish stronger foundations for sustainable growth in the years ahead.

ae.title: New Asia Forum 2026 Targets US$30 Billion in Investment Mobilization, Positions Indonesia as a Gateway to Asia’s Growth
ae.description: JAKARTA, INDONESIA – Media OutReach Newswire – 22 October 2026 – The New Asia Forum (NAF) 2026 aims to mobilize US$30 billion in investment across the New Asia region by strengthening strategic partnerships and accelerating investment execution. Held under the patronage of President Prabowo Subianto, with Danantara Indonesia as a founding partner, the forum will take place on 3–4 December 2026 in Bali, Indonesia. NAF 2026 is designed as an action-oriented platform connecting global investors, industry leaders, and policymakers to advance investment opportunities across strategic sectors. Moving beyond conventional economic dialogue, the forum seeks to translate investment interest into concrete commitments, financing structures, and measurable outcomes. Pahala Nugraha Mansury, Managing Director of Global Relations & Communications at Danantara Indonesia, emphasized Asia's growing potential to attract long-term global capital amid shifting economic and geopolitical dynamics. "Our focus is on encouraging long-term capital to recognize the many investment opportunities across Asian countries, because this is precisely where the center of gravity for growth lies. This will enable growth at scale, anchored by ASEAN and driven by Indonesia as the largest country in ASEAN," said Pahala. The Asia-Pacific region currently accounts for nearly 60% of global economic growth. However, long-term international capital allocation to the region remains below its potential, presenting significant opportunities for greater investment collaboration. NAF 2026 expects to convene more than 1,000 global leaders, feature over 100 speakers, and host more than 40 sessions involving sovereign wealth funds, institutional investors, development finance institutions, multinational corporations, and government representatives. Notable speakers include President Prabowo Subianto of Indonesia; Masayoshi Son, Chairman and CEO of SoftBank Group; Tshering Tobgay, Prime Minister of Bhutan; Kathleen Quirk, Chief Executive Officer of Freeport-McMoRan; Matteo Renzi, former Prime Minister of Italy; and Israfil Mammadov, Chief Executive Officer of the State Oil Fund of the Republic of Azerbaijan. The forum will follow a two-day structure: Discovery & Diligence on 3 December, focusing on investment opportunities, feasibility, and transaction structures; and Action & Execution on 4 December, advancing capital commitments, strategic partnerships, and implementation milestones. Eight priority sectors will anchor the discussions: strategic resources and downstreaming; energy and power; advanced mobility and manufacturing; digital infrastructure and AI; food and agribusiness; trade and connectivity; tourism and creative economy; and education and human capital. As a founding partner, Danantara Indonesia will participate as a co-investor alongside global partners, supporting investment in strategic sectors and reinforcing Indonesia's role in regional economic transformation. Through its transaction-focused approach, NAF 2026 aims to deliver preliminary investment agreements, bankable financing structures, and clearly defined implementation milestones. Investment commitments and progress will be tracked across subsequent editions to promote accountability, continuity, and tangible economic impact for Indonesia and the wider region. The tool turns existing photographs into cutouts or white-background product images that can be resized for each channel. sa.title: «الليث» يكسر صيام 8 مباريات خارج أرضه
sa.description: لم يكن انتصار الشباب على مضيفه الفتح بنتيجة 3-1 في الدوري السعودي للمحترفين مجرد ثلاث نقاط؛ فقد حملت الثلاثية معها نهاية ثلاث فترات من الانتظار، ليخرج «الليث» من أرض منافسه بمكاسب تتجاوز نتيجة المباراة. واستعاد الشباب طعم الفوز على الفتح للمرة الأولى منذ موسم 2023-2024، وأنهى في الوقت ذاته غيابه عن الانتصار على أرض الفتح، الذي استمر منذ موسم 2020-2021. ولم تتوقف مكاسب الشباب عند حدود مواجهاته مع الفتح؛ إذ وضع حداً لسلسلة من ثماني مباريات متتالية خارج أرضه في الدوري دون انتصار، ليستعيد فرحة العودة بالنقاط الثلاث من ملاعب المنافسين. هكذا، حضرت الثلاثية في النتيجة وفي حصيلة المكاسب؛ فوزٌ طال انتظاره أمام الفتح، وانتصارٌ غاب على أرضه، وتعثرٌ خارج الديار وجد نهايته.

sa.title: الفتح يواصل التراجع.. والأزمة مستمرة
sa.description: لم تكن نتائج فريق الفتح في دوري روشن السعودي هذا الموسم على مستوى تطلعات جماهيره، بعدما واصل الفريق تراجعه وعجزه عن تحقيق النتائج المأمولة، لتتواصل معاناته رغم التغيير الفني الذي شهدته المرحلة الماضية، في محاولة لإعادة الفريق إلى مساره الصحيح. وبدأت معاناة «النموذجي» تحت قيادة المدرب الوطني خالد العطوي، الذي لم يتمكن من قيادة الفريق إلى تحقيق النتائج المطلوبة، إذ اكتفى بثلاثة تعادلات مقابل أربع خسائر خلال الجولات السبع الأولى، الأمر الذي دفع إدارة النادي إلى إنهاء العلاقة التعاقدية معه والاستعانة بمدرب جديد لقيادة المرحلة القادمة. لكن التغيير الفني لم ينعكس بالشكل المأمول على نتائج الفريق، إذ استمرت التعثرات، وخسر الفتح أمام الأهلي بنتيجة 4-0، قبل أن يحقق انتصاره الأول في الدوري على حساب الحزم بنتيجة 3-2، ثم عاد إلى الخسائر أمام الخليج بنتيجة 3-2، قبل أن يتلقى خسارة جديدة أمام الشباب بنتيجة 3-1 ضمن الجولة الحادية عشرة. وبعد مرور 11 جولة، تكشف الأرقام حجم المعاناة التي يعيشها الفتح، إذ حقق الفريق فوزاً واحداً، وثلاثة تعادلات، مقابل سبع خسائر، ليجمع ست نقاط فقط، فيما سجل لاعبوه عشرة أهداف واستقبلت شباكه 23 هدفاً، بفارق أهداف بلغ ناقص 13 هدفاً، وهي حصيلة تعكس صعوبة البداية التي يعيشها الفريق هذا الموسم. وتضع هذه الأرقام الجهاز الفني أمام تحدٍ كبيرٍ يتمثل في معالجة الأخطاء الدفاعية، وتحسين الفاعلية الهجومية، واستعادة التوازن داخل الملعب، خصوصاً أن تغيير المدرب لم يحقق حتى الآن التحول المنتظر على مستوى النتائج. وتترقب جماهير الفتح رد فعل مختلفة من اللاعبين خلال الجولات القادمة، على أمل إيقاف نزيف النقاط واستعادة نغمة الانتصارات، والابتعاد عن المراكز المتأخرة، بما يتناسب مع تطلعات محبي «النموذجي» الذين ينتظرون تحسناً ملموساً في أداء الفريق ونتائجه.

iq.description: شفقنيوز- بغداد قررالبنك المركزي العراقي، يوم الخميس، منع مصرف "التنمية الدولي" منالتعامل بالدولار الأميركي بـ"أي شكل من الأشكال". جاءذلك بحسب وثيقة صادرة عن دائرة "الرقابة على المصارف" التابعة للبنكالمركزي، وردت لوكالة شفق نيوز. وأعلنتوزارة الخزانة الأميركية، الخميس الماضي، فرض عقوبات جديدة تستهدف شبكات إيرانيةللالتفاف على العقوبات الدولية شملت 16 فرداً و10 كيانات بينها مصرف عراقي. وشملتالإجراءات في بيان للوزارة ترجمته وكالة شفق نيوز، مصرف التنمية الدولي للاستثماروالتمويل (آي دي بي)، الذي يتخذ من العراق مقراً له، إذ تتهمه واشنطن بتسهيلالمعاملات المالية الإيرانية وتأمين الوصول إلى الدولار الأميركي، فضلاً عنالاحتفاظ بعلاقات مع جهات حكومية إيرانية وجماعات مسلحة متحالفة مع طهران داخلالعراق. ويومالجمعة الماضي، رفضت إدارة مصرف التنمية الدولي للاستثمار والتمويل، ما وصفتهبـ"اتهامات الخزانة الأميركية"، مؤكدة أنها تتعامل بأعلى درجات الجديةوالمسؤولية والشفافية مع التطورات المرتبطة بهذا الشأن.
